string.text: Uwaaaaa! The Commander found me! Do you still remember me, Commander?
SOP-II! I'm so happy to see you again!
I looooove the Commander! But on a mission I can't be with you so... Tadaaaa! For those moments, I made M4 SOPMOD-II Junior! So she can remind you of me when I'm not around!
Ok SOP-II, enough for now. Please head back to base.
